map.算法：点积 a·b = ax·bx + ay·by，|a| = √(ax²+ay: Algorithm: dot product a·b = ax·bx + ay·by, |a| = sqrt(ax2+ay2), |b| = sqrt(bx2+by2); angle theta = arccos(a·b/(|a|·|b|)), output in degrees (radians x 180/pi). Dot product >0 means acute, =0 orthogonal, <0 obtuse. Both vectors must be non-zero (otherwise the denominator is 0 and undefined).
